title: Exploring ESC Winners with Nested Diagrams
abstract: arXiv:2608.13630v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present ConceptFlow, a scikit-learn-compatible Python library for Formal Concept Analysis that constructs and renders nested line diagrams from many-valued formal contexts. Given a many-valued context and a partition of its attributes into conceptual scales, ConceptFlow performs conceptual scaling, computes the factor lattices, identifies filled nodes of the corresponding subdirect product, and produces an interactive visualization.   We apply ConceptFlow to the winners of the Eurovision Song Contest from 1975 to 2025, exploring relationships between voting patterns and musical characteristics. Voting support is captured by an outer scale spanning regional, cultural, historical, and political dimensions, while an inner scale captures musical characteristics via tempo and key. The resulting nested line diagram reveals implications across both scales, exposing dependencies between how winning entries were voted for and the musical prope

translated_title: 探索嵌套图揭示的欧洲歌唱大赛获奖者
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13630v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们介绍了ConceptFlow，一个兼容scikit-learn的Python库，用于形式概念分析，它从多值形式背景中构建并渲染嵌套线图。给定一个多值背景及其属性划分为概念尺度，ConceptFlow执行概念尺度化，计算因子格，识别相应子直接积的填充节点，并生成交互式可视化。我们将ConceptFlow应用于1975年至2025年欧洲歌唱大赛的获奖者，探索投票模式与音乐特征之间的关系。投票支持通过一个外层尺度捕获，涵盖区域、文化、历史和政治维度，而内层尺度通过节奏和调性捕获音乐特征。生成的嵌套线图揭示了两个尺度间的蕴含关系，展示了获奖作品的投票方式与其音乐属性之间的依赖关系。
tldr: 本文提出了一个名为ConceptFlow的Python库，用于形式概念分析中的嵌套线图构建，并将其应用于1975-2025年欧洲歌唱大赛获奖者数据，揭示了投票模式与音乐特征之间的隐含依赖关系。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ConceptFlow, a Python library for building nested line diagrams in Formal Concept Analysis, and applies it to Eurovision Song Contest winners from 1975-2025, revealing implicit dependencies between voting patterns and musical characteristics.
